name: t01v2_look60_fp204_images_02
command:
import json,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
from src.tools.t01v2_live_progress import read_prefix,archive
root=Path.cwd().resolve()
source='pilot_pairs_v2_look60_seq_01_j707558_hopper_m_02_g0_floorplan204'
raw,extent=read_prefix(root/'data/world_pairs/v2'/(source+'_attempts.jsonl'))
rows=[json.loads(line) for line in raw.splitlines() if line.strip()]
rows=[r for r in rows if r.get('status')=='passed' and r.get('kind','').startswith('look_')]
rows=[r for r in rows if r['pair_id']=='floorplan204_00031']
assert rows
out=root/'logs/review/t01v2_look_fov60_fp204_02';out.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
proofs=[]
for row in rows:
 pair=(root/row['pair_file']).resolve();pair.relative_to(root/'data/world_pairs/v2')
 blob=pair.read_bytes();assert hashlib.sha256(blob).hexdigest()==row['pair_sha256']
 d=json.loads(blob);ref=d['review_image'];picture=(root/ref['file']).resolve();picture.relative_to(root)
 image=picture.read_bytes();assert hashlib.sha256(image).hexdigest()==ref['sha256']
 dest=out/(row['pair_id']+'.png');dest.write_bytes(image)
 proofs.append({'journal_row':row,'original_review_image':ref,'published_image':{'file':str(dest.relative_to(root)),'sha256':ref['sha256']}})
proof={'scope':'provisional producer-passed Look pairs; ended-source independent checkpoint pending','source_run':source,'field_of_view':60,'pairs':proofs,'journal_prefix':archive(raw,out,'source_journal.prefix'),'journal_extent':extent}
(out/'provisional.json').write_text(json.dumps(proof,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+'\n')
(out/'README.md').write_text('FOV60 FloorPlan204 provisional Look review images. Source producer-passed images copied unchanged with authenticated references. Independent per-controller checkpoint pending; these are not yet independently accepted.\n')
print(json.dumps({'published_pairs':[r['pair_id'] for r in rows],'review_directory':str(out.relative_to(root))}))
